title: End-to-end interop test with real verify-trust
description: Build verify-trust from ~/GIT/OpenVTC_verifiable-git-infrastructure. Locally: a git-vouch registry, git-vouch-trqp, a generated DID document, and a repo with commits signed by registry keys. OpenVTC's tool is the independent oracle.
acceptance_criteria: verify-trust passes a commit by a registered contributor-or-above key; fails an unregistered key, a revoked key, and a retired key's post-retirement signature; fails closed when the service is down.
